title: Coffee and Tea Business for Sale in Athens, Greece
tagline: • Established specialty coffee roasting group based in Greece, focused on roasting and wholesale and retail distribution. • Core products include specialty-grade roasted coffee beans and ground coffee. • The business has built a recognized specialty coffee brand with an established and loyal customer base across the Greek market. • Processes approximately 250–300 tonnes of coffee annually, demonstrating established production and distribution capabilities. • The group generates approximately €3.2 million in annual revenue, comprising around €1.4 million from the central roasting entity and approximately €0.9 million from each of two retail outlets. • The business serves approximately 75–80 B2B clients, supported by its established wholesale distribution network and long-standing presence in the specialty coffee market. • Wholesale distribution allows the business to serve multiple customers and locations through centralized production, while retail sales provide an additional revenue channel without requiring a proportionate increase in headcount. • The business has been operating for over a decade, with an established market position in Greece. • The combination of specialty-grade products, brand recognition, loyal customers, and established roasting and distribution operations provides a platform for further growth. • Operates with a valid business license.
